verdict.rationale: The marketing homepage says users get AI-driven alerts and strategic insights on spend and return by channel, so the product does claim this capability itself. That claim is a single thin line with no documentation of how the insights work, what data they draw on, or how they are surfaced. Missing for 10: documented detail on the AI insights feature, evidence of actionable AI suggestions, coverage beyond spend-by-channel, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Veja o gasto e retorno  por canal e receba alertas  e insights estratégicos por IA.
